highlightsNote: Every goal plays as its own clip from FIFA's official highlights.

nations.name: Egypt
nations.squad: Final 21 named 7 November; in Doha since 15 November

matches.story: Egypt played from the 23rd minute with ten men and still pulled a goal back: Ziad Saudi's strike from distance, with the keeper at full stretch. Captain Ahmed Safwat started in midfield.
matches.scout: Saudi's goal is the clip clubs will ask for: a clean strike under pressure, in a match Egypt were chasing a man down.
keyNumbers: minutes in which Greece scored twice after the break
points: Qatar on Sunday is a must-not-lose

analysis.h: The red card shaped the match
analysis.p: Egypt lost a player to a second yellow card in the 23rd minute and held 0-0 to half-time. After the break Greece made the extra player count, scoring twice in eight minutes.

analysis.h: Still a threat with ten men
analysis.p: Ziad Saudi's strike from outside the box at 71 minutes kept the match alive. A clean finish under pressure, chasing the game a man down, is exactly the kind of moment clubs ask to see.

analysis.h: What it means for the group
analysis.p: Egypt are on zero points with two matches left. With the eight best third-placed teams also going through, a win against hosts Qatar on Sunday keeps the round of 32 in Egypt's hands.

matches.story: Captain Ahmed Safwat volleyed Egypt ahead inside two minutes and Khaled Mokhtar made it 2-0 after 33. Hosts Qatar pushed for a way back but could not break Egypt's back line. FIFA named Safwat Player of the Match.

analysis.h: The captain set the tone
analysis.p: Safwat scored inside two minutes and was named Player of the Match: the response the side needed after losing to Greece with ten men.

analysis.h: A clean sheet against the hosts
analysis.p: Qatar had won their opener 2-0; Egypt kept them out for 90 minutes.

analysis.h: What it means for the group
analysis.p: Greece beat Panama 2-1 and are through on six points. Egypt are second on three, level with Qatar, before Panama v Egypt on Wednesday 25 November.

matches.scout: Follow captain Ahmed Safwat and Khaled Mokhtar against Panama on 25 November: a win would put Egypt in the round of 32.

nations.name: Côte d'Ivoire
nations.squad: Final 21 named: 3 goalkeepers, 7 defenders, 6 midfielders, 5 forwards

matches.story: Captain Hubert Yao put Côte d'Ivoire ahead after seven minutes. Uzbekistan levelled through Muhammad Khakimov six minutes after half-time, and substitute Abass Luc Diarrassouba won it a minute from time. Three points to open Group E.

analysis.h: Captain sets the tone
analysis.p: Hubert Yao scored inside the first ten minutes, the start a side wants against a well-organised Asian team.

analysis.h: The bench decided it
analysis.p: Uzbekistan were level from the 51st minute. Abass Luc Diarrassouba, on as a substitute, scored the winner in the 89th minute.

analysis.h: What it means for the group
analysis.p: Italy also won, 6-0 against Jamaica, so Italy v Côte d'Ivoire on 23 November is likely to decide first place in Group E.

matches.scout: Follow captain Hubert Yao and match-winner Abass Luc Diarrassouba against Italy on 23 November, the group's benchmark match.

matches.story: Côte d'Ivoire lost for the first time at the tournament. Italy scored from a first-half rebound by Francesco Gasparello and a second-half free kick by Francesco Olivieri. Harafat Diabaté scored a penalty in the tenth minute of added time, after an earlier penalty for Côte d'Ivoire was overturned by VAR.
keyNumbers: shots on target, Italy v Côte d'Ivoire

analysis.h: Italy's quality on the ball
analysis.p: Italy had seven shots on target to three and scored from a rebound and a set piece. Côte d'Ivoire stayed in the match but could not turn pressure into a goal until the last minute.

analysis.h: Still fighting at the end
analysis.p: A first penalty was overturned by VAR; Côte d'Ivoire kept going and Harafat Diabaté scored the second one in the 100th minute. The same late spirit won the opener against Uzbekistan.

analysis.h: What it means for the group
analysis.p: Italy are through to the round of 32. Côte d'Ivoire have three points, level with Uzbekistan, before Jamaica on 26 November; a win takes them to six.

matches.scout: Follow captain Hubert Yao and Harafat Diabaté against Jamaica on 26 November, the match that decides Côte d'Ivoire's place in the round of 32.

matches.story: Croatia scored after eight minutes and Senegal went down to ten men three minutes before half-time, when a player was sent off for a last-man foul. Senegal still equalised before the break through Sega Mbodji and held 1-1 for the whole second half.
keyNumbers: men for the whole second half
point from a group opener against a European side

analysis.h: Character under pressure
analysis.p: Behind early and a man down before half-time, Senegal found an equaliser almost immediately and then kept Croatia out for 45 minutes with ten players. That says as much about the group's organisation as its talent.

analysis.h: What it means for the group
analysis.p: A point against Croatia, the group's main European test, leaves Senegal in control: Cuba and Tajikistan remain, and the eight best third-placed teams also reach the round of 32.

matches.scout: Sega Mbodji is the name to follow against Cuba on 23 November: he scored the goal that saved a point with ten men.

goals.how: On his first start of the tournament
Player of the Match; FIFA's pick of the day's goals

matches.story: Senegal led 5-0 at half-time and won 9-0, the biggest win in their U-17 World Cup history. Seven different players scored, Ibrahima Dione and Sega Mbodji twice each, and Ibrahima Konté was Player of the Match. Senegal go top of Group F on goal difference ahead of Croatia.
keyNumbers: Senegal's biggest U-17 World Cup win
attempts at goal, 13 of Senegal's on target

analysis.h: Settled inside the first half hour
analysis.p: Goals at 7, 14, 21 and 24 minutes put the match away early, and Dione's second made it 5-0 at the break. Senegal kept pressing after half-time and scored four more.

analysis.h: Goals from seven players
analysis.p: Dione and Mbodji scored twice each, Mouhamed Faye scored on his first start and Ibrahima Konté added FIFA's pick of the day's goals. Clubs get a wide pool to follow, not one striker.

analysis.h: Read it against the opponent
analysis.p: Cuba have lost both matches and are out. The Tajikistan match on 26 November is the truer test of this attack against an organised defence.

analysis.h: What it means for the group
analysis.p: Senegal and Croatia both have four points; Senegal lead on goal difference, +9 to +4. With the group likely to be decided on goal difference, today's margin could be worth first place.

matches.scout: Follow Ibrahima Konté, Player of the Match, and two-goal Ibrahima Dione against Tajikistan on 26 November, the match that settles Group F.

goals.how: Swept in from about ten yards after New Zealand failed to clear

matches.story: Mali led through Halidou Maiga after 11 minutes and settled the match with two goals in four minutes after half-time, Maiga's second and Makan Sacko's. A clean sheet against the Oceania champions to open Group G.
keyNumbers: minutes between the second and third goals

analysis.h: A fast start after the break
analysis.p: Mali led 1-0 at half-time, then scored twice in four minutes early in the second half. The match was over before the hour.

analysis.h: What it means for the group
analysis.p: Three points and +3 put Mali top of Group G before the meeting with Belgium on 23 November, the match most European scouts will attend.

matches.scout: Halidou Maiga, with two goals, is the player to follow against Belgium on 23 November.

goals.how: Finish after a back-heel from Al-Hassan Kamara
Volley from outside the box, in off the post

matches.story: Mali came from behind to beat Belgium and became the first African side through to the round of 32. Belgium scored with their first attack; Djigui Koïta volleyed in from outside the box five minutes later and Yaya Niang won it midway through the second half.

analysis.h: Mali ran the match
analysis.p: Mali had 60% of the ball and 19 shots to Belgium's 3. Belgium's goal came from their first real attack, a back-heel from Al-Hassan Kamara finished by Niels Filippo.

analysis.h: An answer inside five minutes
analysis.p: Koïta's volley from outside the box, in off the post, came five minutes after the opener. Going behind against a European side did not change how Mali played.

analysis.h: The work still to do
analysis.p: Only two of the 19 shots were on target. Finishing is what separates this side from a bigger result in the knockout rounds.

analysis.h: What it means for the group
analysis.p: Two wins from two put Mali top of Group G and into the round of 32 with a match to spare. Vietnam on 26 November decides the final placing.

matches.scout: Follow Djigui Koïta and Yaya Niang against Vietnam on 26 November; with Halidou Maiga's two goals against New Zealand, Mali's front line is one clubs should track as a group.

nations.name: Morocco
nations.route: U-17 AFCON hosts, topped Group A

matches.story: Morocco were 2-0 up inside five minutes and 3-0 at half-time. Ziyad Baha scored twice early in the second half, one a penalty, and substitute Rami Lougmani added the sixth. Morocco top Group H after the first round.

analysis.h: Goals from everywhere
analysis.p: Five different players scored, including a substitute. Ismail El Aoud scored one and set up another in the first five minutes.

analysis.h: Baha delivers again
analysis.p: Playing his second U-17 World Cup, Ziyad Baha scored twice in six minutes after the break, the kind of tournament experience clubs pay attention to.

analysis.h: What it means for the group
analysis.p: Morocco lead Group H on goal difference before China PR on 23 November and Spain on 26 November, the match that will likely decide first place.

matches.scout: Follow Ziyad Baha and Ismail El Aoud against China PR on 23 November, then the headline meeting with Spain.

goals.how: The equaliser in the ninth minute of added time

matches.story: China PR scored after two minutes and again before the hour, both through Zhao Songyuan. Ziyad Baha's penalty on 64 minutes started the comeback and Rami Lougmani equalised in the ninth minute of added time. Morocco stay unbeaten with four points before Spain.
keyNumbers: goals in two matches for Ziyad Baha

analysis.h: A slow start punished
analysis.p: China PR scored inside two minutes with a powerful angled strike and defended in a compact block. Morocco had the ball but few clear openings before half-time.

analysis.h: Baha takes responsibility again
analysis.p: Ziyad Baha scored from the spot on 64 minutes, his third goal in two matches and his second penalty. Clubs watching for a reliable finisher under pressure have their answer.

analysis.h: Lougmani, twice from nowhere
analysis.p: Rami Lougmani scored late against Fiji and now in the 99th minute against China PR. Two goals in two matches from a player who keeps arriving at the right moment.

analysis.h: What it means for the group
analysis.p: Spain beat Fiji 15-0 and have six points. Morocco have four and must beat Spain on 26 November to win Group H; a draw still leaves them well placed for the round of 32.

matches.scout: Follow Ziyad Baha and Rami Lougmani against Spain on 26 November, the group's headline match and the best measure yet of Morocco's attack.

nations.name: Tanzania
nations.squad: Final 21 named, home-based and foreign-based players

matches.story: Tanzania's first match at a U-17 World Cup. Costa Rica led 2-0 after 15 minutes, then Faraji Kayanda scored twice after half-time to earn a 2-2 draw and FIFA's Player of the Match award. A first World Cup point for the Serengeti Boys.
keyNumbers: first World Cup point for Tanzania

analysis.h: A slow start
analysis.p: Costa Rica scored twice in the first 15 minutes. Coach Elieneza Nsanganzelu pointed to early defensive lapses.

analysis.h: Kayanda turned it round
analysis.p: Faraji Kayanda scored in the 51st and 73rd minutes, and FIFA named him Player of the Match.

analysis.h: What it means for the group
analysis.p: Brazil beat Republic of Ireland 2-1, so Brazil lead Group I and Tanzania share second place with Costa Rica. Brazil v Tanzania is on Tuesday 24 November.

matches.scout: Follow Faraji Kayanda against Brazil on 24 November: two goals in his first World Cup match, against a side that led 2-0.

matches.story: Algeria's first U-17 World Cup match in 17 years. Ilyes Mekkaoui and Yacine Abed put them 2-0 up inside 15 minutes, but Chile scored three times before half-time and added a fourth eight minutes from the end.
keyNumbers: minutes in which Chile scored three
years since Algeria's last U-17 World Cup

analysis.h: A fast start
analysis.p: Mekkaoui scored after eight minutes and Abed made it 2-0 after 15: Algeria pressed Chile high from the kick-off.

analysis.h: Thirteen minutes changed the match
analysis.p: Chile scored at 21, 28 and 34 minutes. Holding a lead is the lesson to take into the next two matches.

analysis.h: What it means for the group
analysis.p: Dominican Republic and Montenegro drew 1-1, so Chile lead Group J. Algeria play Montenegro on 24 November, and a win would put them back in the race for the round of 32.

matches.scout: Mekkaoui and Abed both scored against Chile: follow them against Montenegro on 24 November.

nations.name: Cameroon
nations.squad: Final 21 registered with FIFA; in Doha since 7 November

matches.story: Venezuela led through Román Lozada before half-time and Santiago Sánchez just before the hour. Eric Bolo was sent off for a second yellow card late on, and Aviel Hentcho pulled one back for Cameroon in added time.
keyNumbers: men at the end, after a second yellow card

analysis.h: Venezuela took their chances
analysis.p: Román Lozada, FIFA's Player of the Match, scored after 29 minutes and Santiago Sánchez doubled the lead after 59.

analysis.h: A late reply with ten men
analysis.p: Eric Bolo was sent off late on; Aviel Hentcho still scored in added time.

analysis.h: What it means for the group
analysis.p: Mexico beat Romania 1-0, so Venezuela and Mexico lead Group K. Cameroon play Mexico on 24 November and need points to stay in the race.

matches.scout: Aviel Hentcho scored with Cameroon down to ten men: follow him against Mexico on 24 November.

nations.name: Mozambique
nations.route: Play-off: 1-1 with Ethiopia, won 5-4 on penalties

goals.how: Finish from the edge of the box after a break; assist Chausson Nhabanga
Sliding finish at the near post on the counter
Into an empty net after the keeper was beaten

matches.story: Africa's first win of the tournament, in Mozambique's first U-17 World Cup match. They led inside four minutes and were 3-0 up at half-time. Captain Diego Elias Pelembe ran midfield with Khensane Machel and Valentim Pacane. Mozambique top Group C after Australia beat Argentina 2-0.
matches.scout: Machel and Cuna Júnior are the names to follow against Argentina on Sunday: both scored from fast breaks against a European side.

analysis.h: Built to hurt teams on the break
analysis.p: Two of the first three goals came from fast breaks: Machel finishing from the edge of the box four minutes in, then Cuna Júnior sliding in at the near post on a counter. Denmark had to commit players forward and Mozambique punished the space behind them.

analysis.h: The game was won before half-time
analysis.p: Goals at 4, 32 and 44 minutes meant Mozambique could manage the second half, and they still added a fourth in added time. For a side in its first U-17 World Cup, controlling a European opponent for 90 minutes is the headline.

analysis.h: Goals from three different players
analysis.p: Machel, Cuna Júnior and Mubai all scored: the threat is spread across the team, which makes Mozambique harder to plan against.

analysis.h: What it means for the group
analysis.p: Three points and a +4 goal difference put Mozambique top of Group C. The group winners, the runners-up and the eight best third-placed teams reach the round of 32, so another result against Argentina or Australia would all but secure a place. Argentina lost 2-0 to Australia and must now come at Mozambique, which suits a side this quick on the break.

matches.story: Argentina scored after five minutes and again after 32. Alírio Cuna Júnior pulled one back in first-half added time, his third goal of the tournament, but Argentina held on for their first win.
keyNumbers: goals for Alírio Cuna Júnior in two matches
goal difference, second in Group C

analysis.h: An early setback
analysis.p: Argentina led after five minutes, the opposite of the start Mozambique made against Denmark.

analysis.h: Cuna Júnior again
analysis.p: His goal just before half-time made it three in two matches, Africa's leading scorer so far at the tournament.

analysis.h: What it means for the group
analysis.p: Denmark and Australia drew 0-0. Australia lead Group C on four points; Mozambique are second on three with a +3 goal difference, ahead of Argentina, before meeting Australia on Wednesday 25 November.

matches.scout: Alírio Cuna Júnior has three goals in two matches: follow him and captain Diego Elias Pelembe against Australia on 25 November.

nations.name: Uganda
nations.route: Play-off: 2-2 with Ghana, won 8-7 on penalties

matches.story: A hard opener against an Asian side that scored early. Uganda were 1-0 down at half-time and created a clear chance of their own before Korea pulled away.
matches.scout: Ecuador on Sunday is the match that decides Uganda's group, and the one to watch their squad in.
keyNumbers: at half-time: still in the match
matches left: Ecuador and New Caledonia

analysis.h: An early goal set the tone
analysis.p: Korea Republic scored in the 8th minute and Uganda spent the match chasing. They stayed in it until half-time at 1-0 and created a clear chance of their own before a deflected shot made it 2-0 early in the second half.

analysis.h: What it means for the group
analysis.p: Uganda are bottom of Group B after the opener, but two matches remain against Ecuador and New Caledonia, and the eight best third-placed teams also reach the round of 32. Ecuador on Sunday is the match that decides their tournament.

matches.story: Uganda held Ecuador, winners of their opening match, to a goalless draw: Uganda's first point at a U-17 World Cup. Uganda's defence held out at the end, and their attacks kept Ecuador's goalkeeper busy.
keyNumbers: first U-17 World Cup point for Uganda
goals conceded in the opener, against Korea Republic

analysis.h: A defensive reply
analysis.p: After the 3-0 defeat by Korea Republic, Uganda kept Ecuador out for 90 minutes; their goalkeeper made several saves.

analysis.h: Chances, not yet goals
analysis.p: Uganda made Ecuador's goalkeeper work: he saved again and again in the first half, twice in a minute just before the break. The chances are there; the first goal is the next step against New Caledonia.

analysis.h: What it means for the group
analysis.p: Korea Republic beat New Caledonia 6-0 and are through. Uganda are third with one point before meeting New Caledonia on 25 November; a win would take them to four points and keep the round of 32 in reach.

matches.scout: Uganda's defence held Ecuador: follow the back line and the first goal against New Caledonia on 25 November.

moments.how: Uganda's first chance of the match, kept out
Uganda's best spell before half-time, both chances kept out by Ecuador's goalkeeper

moments.who: Uganda hold firm at close range
moments.how: Uganda's goalkeeper and defence block Ecuador's late chance in the six-yard box
